eventDetail.scope: The Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC) focuses on advancing the theory and practice of software engineering. It covers a broad spectrum of topics, including software design, development, testing, maintenance, and evolution, as well as emerging areas such as AI-driven software engineering, cyber-physical systems, and autonomous systems. The conference aims to bridge academia and industry by addressing real-world challenges, promoting empirical studies, and fostering innovation in software engineering methodologies, tools, and practices.
